name: Star charge
description: Contact invincibility for 7 seconds. Falls remain dangerous.

name: Nova bloom
description: Orbiting stars strike nearby enemies for 10 seconds.

name: Fire fruit
description: Automatically launch fireballs at nearby enemies for 12 seconds; ignore fire-imp contact.

name: Ice blossom
description: Freeze nearby foes and fire slowing ice shards for 12 seconds.

name: Giant heart
description: Gain up to five hearts for 20 seconds; revert safely afterward.

name: Thunder totem
description: Lightning strikes nearby enemies for 12 seconds.

name: Phase crystal
description: Pass through breakable bricks and cache blocks; ignore contact damage for 6 seconds. Solid ground stays solid.

name: Phoenix feather
description: One automatic rescue from a fall.

name: Bomba cache
description: Immediately detonate a safe shockwave around you.
